name: D01
summary: Sharpa's first full robot, launched at IROS 2026: 7-DoF arms with Sharpa's tactile hands, electronic skin over the body (10 mm, 0.2 N resolution), Jetson Thor compute and control loops up to 1 kHz. The listed ~40 kg excludes the chassis. Sharpa is taking sales enquiries with no public price.

sources.title: Sharpa Launches D01 Robot, W02 Hand and AE01 Haptic Glove at IROS 2026 — Humanoids Daily
